notes: Very distinctive full name (surname Yetukuri), so ambiguity risk is low. Verified across TWO independent domains that agree on four criteria: (1) yashodahospitals.com - his own doctor page at the hitec-city/neuro-surgery slug, plus his online-consultation booking page titled 'Dr. B. Bala Raja Sekhar Chandra Y - Senior Consultant Neuro & Spine Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals', plus the health-talk and spine-surgery panel pages: name + specialty (Neuro & Spine Surgery) + hospital (Yashoda Hitec City) + city + the exact title in the input row, 'Sr. Consultant Neuro & Spine Surgeon and Clinical Director - Advance Endoscopic Spine Surgery'; (2) drbalarajasekhar.com - his OWN professional website, which independently states 'Senior Consultant Neuro & Spine Surgeon at Yashoda Hospitals, Hitech city' and gives his training (MBBS Osmania Medical College, MS and MCh from PGIMER Chandigarh) and subspecialty (endoscopic spine surgery, UBE discectomy). Band recorded as High on the strength of those two independent, non-directory domains agreeing on role AND hospital. Reviewer nuance: section 5 of the brief enumerates 'official source' as hospital site / Apollo247 / .gov.in / academic / ORCID / Scholar and does not explicitly name a doctor's own website, so a strict reading of that list would put this at Medium (one hospital domain, many pages). I judged the self-published professional site to be independent corroboration of role and affiliation rather than a directory; downgrade to Medium if you disagree. PHONES DELIBERATELY NOT RECORDED: his contact page publishes two enquiry numbers, labelled domestic and international, in India's 10-digit mobile numbering series (89779xxxxx). They are published practice enquiry lines with stated consulting hours, not 'cell' labels, but they are mobile-series numbers and the operating rule for this batch excludes mobile numbers, so neither was transcribed into professional_phone or secretary_number. A human who wants them can read them directly from the cited page https://drbalarajasekhar.com/contact-us/ and should confirm they reach the office rather than a personal handset. No email address appeared anywhere in search output, so professional_email is blank rather than derived. SCHOLARLY IDs: a targeted publications query on the surname Yetukuri returned only generic endoscopic-spine-surgery literature by other authors - no paper, ORCID iD, Google Scholar or ResearchGate profile attributable to him, so those fields are blank; per the brief this absence is the normal result for Hyderabad private-practice clinicians. EXPERIENCE CONFLICT FOR HUMAN REVIEW: Yashoda's profile says 'over 16 years', his own site says 'over 23 years', and the input row says 17 years. All three are recorded in verified_experience rather than picking one; the 23-year figure may count total post-MBBS service and the 16-17 figure post-MCh neurosurgical practice. SAME-NAME TRAP AVOIDED: a query on his website domain surfaced a DIFFERENT doctor, 'Dr Rajasekhar Reddy K', also described as a consultant neurosurgeon and spine surgeon at Yashoda Hitec City, who runs 'Dr Rajashekhar Reddy Neuro & Spine Clinic' at KPHB Colony. Different surname (Reddy K, not Yetukuri) and a different clinic - nothing from that person (the KPHB clinic address or its Practo clinic page) was recorded here, and owns_clinic is left false for Yetukuri because no clinic of his own was evidenced. Skedoc lists him with a misspelt slug ('bala-raja-sehkar-chandra-yetkuri') but it is the same person, and Lybrate uses the shortened 'Dr. Bala Rajasekhar Yetukuri'; both are corroborating directories only.
